name: Pieter Heye
title: Provisional Psychologist
description: Experienced mental health practitioner (+15 years) with particular expertise in cultural sensitive and gender-affirming, psychotherapeutic and sexological care for LGBTQ+ people, people living with hiv, and persons who were forced to flee their country.

name: Pooja Rai
title: Psychologist
description: Experience supporting LGBTQ+ communities and Aboriginal clients with depression, anxiety, trauma, PTSD and relationship challenges. Uses Person Centred Therapy and CBT incorporating ACT, DBT and Schema Therapy; especially passionate about helping clients navigate interpersonal trauma.
specialties: trauma, PTSD, LGBTQ+, schema therapy, domestic violence

name: Sudipta Majumdar
title: Psychologist
description: Trauma-informed approach drawing on CBT, DBT, mindfulness and Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing (EMDR). Special interest in anxiety, OCD, trauma histories and complex clinical presentations.

name: Yee Han Wong
title: Provisional Psychologist
description: As part of the LGBTQIA+ community, he values collaborating with clients to create a safe and supportive environment. Interested in expanding into trauma recovery and neurodiversity support; sessions in English or Mandarin at Melbourne CBD and Brandon Park.
specialties: LGBTQIA+, Mandarin, culturally attuned, trauma recovery

name: Dr Joseph Sakdalan
title: Clinical Psychologist / Clinical Neuropsychologist
description: 25+ years across primary care, inpatient and forensic mental health. Utilises CBT and third wave therapies including DBT, ACT and Schema Therapy, plus Contemporary Psychodynamic Therapy; works with trauma and complex presentations.
specialties: schema therapy, DBT, forensic, neuropsychology, trauma
